target.statement: Squared robust Interval-Mahalanobis distance and Shapley value decomposition for the Cars dataset (27 observations, 4 interval variables), reproducing the outlier flags and Shapley values shown in Figures 1-3.
target.dataset: Cars dataset (MAINT.Data R package, 27 observations, 4 interval-valued variables)

compute.basis: Tiny 27x4 interval dataset; IMCD + closed-form Shapley values run in seconds in R; only package install and data load dominate.

title: Explainable Outlier Detection for Interval-valued Data
